projects.title: Nonlinear FEA of Elastic-Plastic Behavior
projects.titleZh: 弹塑性非线性有限元分析
projects.desc: Nonlinear finite element analysis of elastic-plastic deformation in a structural component under cyclic loading, with material hardening and contact nonlinearity.
projects.descZh: 结构件在循环载荷下的弹塑性变形非线性有限元分析，包含材料硬化和接触非线性。

projects.title: Adaptive Robotic Gripper
projects.desc: Design and structural analysis of an underactuated compliant gripper for delicate object manipulation, validated through FEA and 3D-printed prototypes.
projects.descZh: 欠驱动柔顺抓爪的设计与结构分析，用于精密物体操作，通过有限元分析和3D打印原型验证。

projects.title: Structural Component Optimization
projects.desc: Density-based topology optimization of a structural bracket, achieving significant mass reduction while maintaining structural integrity under multi-axial loading.
projects.descZh: 基于密度法的结构支架拓扑优化，在多轴载荷下实现显著减重并保持结构完整性。
